main.summary: Ordered durable deletion-job stages used to resume cleanup after interruption.

field.name: CatalogPending
field.summary: The catalog item is pending deletion and token-scoped artifacts remain to be removed.

field.name: PublishedArtifactsRemoved
field.summary: Published artifacts for the item instance have been removed.

field.name: TransferStateRemoved
field.summary: Transfer sessions and publication journals for the item instance have been removed.

main.summary: Persisted deletion progress and retry state for one catalog item instance.

property.name: ItemInstanceToken
property.summary: Token identifying this continuous item instance and distinguishing jobs when an item ID is reused.

property.name: LastError
property.summary: Most recent failure detail, if an attempt failed.

property.name: AttemptCount
property.summary: Total number of recorded failed attempts.

property.name: LastAttempt
property.summary: UTC time of the most recent attempt, if one has run.

property.name: NextAttempt
property.summary: UTC time when retry is next due, or null when immediately eligible.

property.name: Created
property.summary: UTC time when the job was first created.

property.name: Updated
property.summary: UTC time when the job was last changed.
